question: LONG LIFE on E-food: does K1 (periodic full resets, the record's best-supported setting) reach W = 2 consecutive sustained lives sooner than the baseline within 1,000,000 decisions — and, beside it and deciding nothing by test, which of K1/K2 still learns late in a long life?
frozen_by: docs/ORDERS.md J18 (ruling 122 terms; ruling 123 continuation rule in experiments/forge/continuation.py); the commit of this file is the freeze. Round 1's files are untouched.

parent.control_source: C1/C2 (plain variation, Random('forge-control-1'/'-2')) ran at r1 rungs S and M; rung M read under lock 2eb2c0f4, pin b9914a75 (705ea61f)

world.arm: E-food exactly as E2c ran it (experiments/pilot_b2.py E2C_ARMS['E-food'] = pilot arm K + handed_sense 'food', encoding 'cossin', trace on)
world.venue: Kaggle CPU kernels with E2c's pins (mujoco 3.17.0); no box run is set beside a kernel run (INBOX 11-21 07:32)

E-food-lr0.note: the baseline never training, same world, same seeds

candidates.prior: PUBLISHED_PRIORS §21 recipe (b), §19 — Nikishin 2022 (2205.07802) DMC IQM 501 -> 656 with periodic resets; Nauman 2024 (2403.00514) 'the most robust intervention'; r1 rung M (lock 2eb2c0f4): late-half sustained rate 0.84 vs baseline 0.059
candidates.change: full network resets every 50,000 decisions, replay and temperature kept

candidates.prior: §21 recipe (c) — Kuznetsov 2020 (2005.04269): truncation controls overestimation, reduces seed variance; §16 Zoo TQC Humanoid 7,239 vs SAC 6,232; r1 rung M (lock 2eb2c0f4): late-half sustained rate 0.82
candidates.change: TQC in place of SAC, 2 top quantiles dropped per net, everything else the baseline

outcome.definition: share of the run's LATE-half lives (lives ending after half the rung's decisions) that are sustained by the harness mark (ruling 22: reached the life cap AND intake >= basal drain); experiments/forge/metric.py
outcome.tiebreak: late meals per life (mean over the same late lives), used only to order arms equal on the score
outcome.crash: a crashed, NaN or cut run scores 0 and counts against its arm

primary.test: experiments.harness.compare(K1, E-food) — two looks, 10 then 20 runs an arm (LOOKS = (10, 20)), alpha 0.025 each look, permutation log-rank; FUTILE at look 1 when <= 1 run of BOTH arms crosses
primary.outcome: experiments.harness.outcome_sustained(lives, W=2, T=1,000,000): decisions until W consecutive sustained lives (ruling 22 mark), censored at T; a crashed/cut run is entered as a crash, never replaced (check #13)
primary.W_source: unchanged from E2c / pilot 2's frozen rule (e2c3c378, W = 2 on both floor cards, DECISIONS_RESOLVED ruling on the motor frame); the world is E-food exactly as E2c ran it
primary.look_1: tranche 1 seeds 1421-1430 of K1 and E-food
primary.look_2: plus tranche 2 seeds 1431-1440, launched only if look 1 is neither A_DIFFERS nor FUTILE

beside.arms: K2 on 1421-1430, the never-trains twin E-food-lr0 on 1421-1422; decide nothing by test
readings: rung M's late-half sustained rate (experiments/forge/metric.py, the frozen hash below) for every run
long-life reading: sustained rate over lives ending in (800k, 1M] against lives ending in (300k, 500k], per run

keep_rule: Frozen now (ruling 122): if look 1 or look 2 says K1 differs from the baseline, brain B's keep setting for stage 2 is whichever of K1/K2 has the higher late-half sustained-rate MEAN at 1M over seeds 1421-1430; if the two means are closer than K1's own seed range (max - min of K1's ten late-half rates), K1 (the record's). If K1 does not differ, no keep setting is chosen by this round.

ladder.rule: none: a continuation round runs rung L once; no climb (experiments/forge/continuation.py)
ladder.readings: the forge's four readings (INBOX 11-20 14:35) stand, per J18

budget.derivation: rung M's 30 raw cells: 300k took 2.2-5.5 h wall, so 1M = 7.5 / 16.9 / 18.3 h (min/med/max); 4 runs a kernel; tranche 1 = 8 kernels x <= 18.3 h ~ 146 of 180 kernel-h; tranche 2 = 5 kernels, its own 180 kernel-h, only when look 2 is needed. core_hours = 4 x kernel_hours. Over either tranche's line the round stops; it does not borrow.

machine.box: no learner run on the box
machine.launch_order: tranche 1 kernels g1-0..g1-4 (K1 + E-food only) first, then g1-5..g1-7 (K2, twin)

acceptance: no result row is accepted (written to results.jsonl) before ORDERS S13 (b)'s judge-hash tripwire holds; the verdict waits for S20's reader (r1_read is locked to r1); rates may be printed before it
forge_filled: J18/ruling 122 silent on these, filled at the freeze: W = 2 and T = 1,000,000 for the primary outcome (W unchanged from E2c's frozen rule, T = the rung); K1's reset points every 50,000 through 950,000 (the same interval as S and M, 19 resets); core_hours = 4 x kernel_hours as in r1; the long-life window (300k, 500k] vs (800k, 1M] read as 'last 200k against 300k-500k' by lives' END; keep-rule seed range = K1's max - min over 1421-1430.
